Digest an R object

Source: R/refresh-snapshot.R
fresh_digest.Rd

Usage

fresh_digest(x)

Arguments

x

Any R object.

Value

character(1) A 64-character lowercase hex string.

Details

The SHA-256 of an R object's serialization (format version 2, skipping R's serialization header), as recorded for snapshot objects and combined by fresh_fingerprint(). It digests the object rather than a file, so the same object saved by different R versions or with different compression has the same digest.

Objects that are identical() can still digest differently if their strings use different encodings (e.g. UTF-8 vs latin1) or their attributes were set in a different order. A deterministic build doesn't do that.

See also

Other refresh: fresh_fingerprint(), fresh_inputs_hash(), package_versions(), read_snapshot(), write_snapshot_json()

Examples

fresh_digest(mtcars)
#> [1] "600df8759318fe0d3e7cd227dfb889264b9395236a2336b9c1d32f83ed509279"
